messages.text: What is eye diagram, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

The passages do not provide a formal definition of an eye diagram; they only identify it as a high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity item alongside insertion loss/crosstalk, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and transmission-line calculation in the R&S signal-integrity flow [65], and as something evaluated through eye-opening metrics such as eye height and eye width in PCIe Gen5 context [5].
| Decision | Supported answer |
|---|---|
| Whether eye-diagram analysis is part of the high-speed PCB/PCBA SI workflow | Yes: the raw R&S flow lists “IL/Xtalk/Eye diagram” under “Signal integrity flow of high speed PCB/PCBA” [65]. |
| Whether to select R&S ZNA-K20 on an R&S ZNA | R&S ZNA-K20 is “Extended time domain analysis including eye diagram,” and it requires R&S ZNA-K2 time-domain analysis/TDR [26]. |
| Whether to select R&S ZNA-K20 on an R&S ZNA67EXT system | R&S ZNA67EXT also lists R&S ZNA-K20 as “Extended time domain analysis (including eye diagram),” requiring R&S ZNA-K2 [36]. |
| Whether TDR/time-domain capability is needed before eye-diagram capability | For both ZNA and ZNA67EXT, the eye-diagram option K20 requires K2, which is the time-domain analysis/TDR option [26][36]. |
| Which VNA family/range to consider if those options are needed | R&S ZNA is a Vector Network Analyzer series covering ZNA26/ZNA43/ZNA50/ZNA67 up to 67 GHz [25], while R&S ZNA67EXT is a 1.0 mm VNA system covering 10 MHz to 110 GHz [33]. |
【推論】If a customer’s PCB/PCBA SI task includes “Eye diagram” as in the raw R&S flow, then the relevant R&S option decision is whether to include K20, and because K20 requires K2, whether to include K2 as well [65][26][36].

[[R&S PCB test solutions]] 是 [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] Slide 21 對 PCB Fabricator and System House 的 PCB / high-speed digital 測試流程摘要，涵蓋 material measurement、stackup selection、signal integrity modeling/testing、sampling testing 與 process monitoring。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。

| [[PCIe Gen4]] | 15 ± 1.5 mV | 0.3 UI（18.75 ± 0.55 ps） | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |
| [[PCIe Gen5]] | 15 ± 1.5 mV | 0.3 UI（9.375 ± 0.5 ps） | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |

- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 minimum eye width 與 eye height 在 post-equalization、3-tap DFE blocks 之前量測。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 PCIe redriver output 的 eye opening 需要大於或等於表列 eye opening 數值。

snla426 › 重點摘要
- 來源比較 Ultra Low Loss material 與 standard loss material，並指出 Megtron 6 等 ultra low-loss material 在高溫下 insertion loss 預期比 nominal temperature 高最多 8%，FR4 等 higher loss material 在高溫下比 nominal temperature 高 11%。
- 來源定義 high-speed signals 最可能影響其他 signals 或被其他 signals 影響，因此應在 PCB design process 早期 layout，最好最先 layout。
- 來源列出 [[Texas Instruments]] PCIe device critical signals：PCIE_RXP、PCIE_RXN、PCIE_TXP、PCIE_TXN、REFCLKP/N（100 MHz Reference CLK）。
- 來源指出 PCB materials / building block、PCB layout、connectors、passive components 等都需視為 RF elements，因為它們會影響 signal characteristics。
- 來源說 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 epoxy 的 static permittivity（εr）差異會造成不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities；fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- 來源指出 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異，進而在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率造成 transmission media 的 return loss 或 insertion loss resonance / anti-resonance。
- 來源說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]；skew 會劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram，並造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。
- 來源指出降低 PCB fiber weave 影響的兩種常見方法：將整個 signaling image plane 相對於 PCB fiber weave 旋轉 10° 到 35°；或將 high-speed differential signals 以 zig-zag 方式跨 PCB routing。
- 來源說應選擇 tighter weave、less epoxy、greater εr uniformity across longer trace lengths 的 PCB style，並在送交 fabrication 前指定最能支援 high-speed signals 的 PCB style。
- 來源列出 1 inch trace 在不同 PCB materials / frequency 下的 insertion loss（SDD21），包括 Megtron 6、Roger、GETEK、Nelco 4000-6、FR4、Tetra Functional FR4。
- 來源說 Loss tangent（Df）或 Dissipation Factor 是 signal 沿 transmission line 傳播時 signal attenuation 的量測；dielectric loss 來自 dielectric material 對 electromagnetic wave 的吸收，且 frequency 增加時 dielectric loss 也成比例增加。

snla426 › 重點摘要
- [[Texas Instruments]] application note《High-Speed PCB Layout for PCIe Gen 5》文件編號為 SNLA426，作者為 Vicente Flores Prado，發布時間為 June 2023。
- 來源目標是協助熟悉 [[PCB manufacturing]]、[[PCB layout]] 與 design 的系統設計者，理解 high-speed [[PCI Express]] 平台的 [[PCB layout]] best practices 與 layout options。
- 來源指出 [[PCIe Gen5]] 的資料傳輸速率為 32 GT/s；Gen5 x16 lane 設計需以最佳化 [[crosstalk]]、[[return loss]]、[[insertion loss]] 為核心。
- 來源稱 [[PCIe Gen5]] layout 面臨 traces、vias、reference planes、dielectrics 等高資料率挑戰。
- 來源說 [[PCIe Gen5]] 與較低速率都使用 differential AC coupled transmission lines；[[PCIe]] 使用 NRZ data，因此允許 polarity inversion。
- 來源說 [[PCIe]] 具 on-chip termination，在 Rx detect process 於 inputs 與 outputs asserted 後啟用，用於 [[signal integrity]]。
- 來源說 [[PCIe Gen3]] 到 [[PCIe Gen5]] 使用 link training，允許 TX 與 RX link equalization。
- 來源列出 loss budget：[[PCIe Gen3]] total system loss 23.5 dB；[[PCIe Gen4]] total system loss 28 dB；[[PCIe Gen5]] total system loss 36 dB，且 Gen5 crosstalk mitigation 為 4–5 dB、temperature / humidity loss 為 2–3 dB。
- 來源列出 eye opening requirements：[[PCIe Gen5]] extrapolated eye height after EQ 為 15 ± 1.5 mV，minimum eye width after EQ 為 0.3 UI（9.375 ± 0.5 ps）。
- 來源指出 Gen5 crosstalk 必須納入 total channel loss 考量；Gen5 至少需要比 total system loss 增加 4–5 dB signal strength，以改善 signal-to-noise ratio 與目標 BER 1E-12。
- 來源指出 crosstalk mitigation 可透過降低 differential signal insertion loss（SDD21）或改善 crosstalk 達成；方法包括最大化 pair-to-pair spacing、ground stitching、最佳化 via anti-pads，並通常建議使用 closely coupled strip line。
- 來源指出 [[TI DS320PR1601 EVM]] 使用 co-planar GND reference waveguide 以降低 crosstalk 影響。

R&S ZNA › Measurement speed
- Measurement speed 測試條件：firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)。
- Acquisition time per point：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog wideband 時 1 µs；30 MHz measurement bandwidth 時 32 ns。
- Linear frequency sweep 條件 201 points、10 GHz center frequency、200 MHz span：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog normal 時 time per sweep < 3.9 ms；sweep cycle time < 4.9 ms。
- IEC/IEEE VXI11 over 1 Gbit/s LAN：201 measurement points、800 MHz start frequency、1 GHz stop frequency、1 MHz measurement bandwidth 的 measurement and data transfer time 為 14 ms / 13 ms；201 measurement points magnitude 的 data transfer time 為 1.7 ms / 0.9 ms。
- Switching time between channels with a maximum of 2001 points：< 2 ms。
- Continuous mode 不需要額外 data transfer time，因為 data transfer 與 measurement 同時進行。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。

- Specification 適用於 10 Hz measurement bandwidth，未套用 user correction；使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range；來源說明 crosstalk 不限制 dynamic range。
- R&S®ZNA-B3n 條件下，receiver step attenuator 為 0 dB position；n 代表 port number 1/2/3/4。
- R&S®ZNA26/43/50/67 的 system dynamic range，1 GHz to 16 GHz：spec. > 129 dB、typ. 139 dB；meas. spec. > 137 dB、typ. meas. 147 dB。
- R&S®ZNA50/R&S®ZNA67，40 GHz to 50 GHz：spec. > 106 dB、typ. 116 dB；meas. spec. > 112 dB、typ. meas. 122 dB。
- R&S®ZNA67，50 GHz to 67 GHz：spec. > 102 dB、typ. 112 dB；meas. spec. > 107 dB、typ. meas. 117 dB。
- Standard configuration noise level，1 kHz measurement bandwidth normalized to 1 Hz，base unit 500 MHz to 30 GHz：spec. < –120 dBm、typ. –132 dBm。
- Standard configuration noise level，1 kHz measurement bandwidth normalized to 1 Hz，base unit 50 GHz to 67 GHz：spec. < –104 dBm、typ. –119 dBm。
- Reversed coupler configuration，base unit + R&S®ZNAxx-B16 + R&S®ZNAxx-B3n，50 GHz to 67 GHz：spec. < –116 dBm、typ. –130 dBm。

R&S ZNA › Frequency accuracy 與 measurement bandwidth
- Static frequency accuracy 公式：time since last adjustment in years × aging per year + temperature drift + achievable initial calibration accuracy。
- Aging per year：standard ±1 × 10–6；with [[R&S ZNA-B4]] precision frequency reference option ±1 × 10–7。

The passages do not provide a formal definition of an eye diagram; they only identify it as a high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity item alongside insertion loss/crosstalk, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and transmission-line calculation in the R&S signal-integrity flow [65], and as something evaluated through eye-opening metrics such as eye height and eye width in PCIe Gen5 context [5].
| Decision | Supported answer |
|---|---|
| Whether eye-diagram analysis is part of the high-speed PCB/PCBA SI workflow | Yes: the raw R&S flow lists “IL/Xtalk/Eye diagram” under “Signal integrity flow of high speed PCB/PCBA” [65]. |
| Whether to select R&S ZNA-K20 on an R&S ZNA | R&S ZNA-K20 is “Extended time domain analysis including eye diagram,” and it requires R&S ZNA-K2 time-domain analysis/TDR [26]. |
| Whether to select R&S ZNA-K20 on an R&S ZNA67EXT system | R&S ZNA67EXT also lists R&S ZNA-K20 as “Extended time domain analysis (including eye diagram),” requiring R&S ZNA-K2 [36]. |
| Whether TDR/time-domain capability is needed before eye-diagram capability | For both ZNA and ZNA67EXT, the eye-diagram option K20 requires K2, which is the time-domain analysis/TDR option [26][36]. |
| Which VNA family/range to consider if those options are needed | R&S ZNA is a Vector Network Analyzer series covering ZNA26/ZNA43/ZNA50/ZNA67 up to 67 GHz [25], while R&S ZNA67EXT is a 1.0 mm VNA system covering 10 MHz to 110 GHz [33]. |
【推論】If a customer’s PCB/PCBA SI task includes “Eye diagram” as in the raw R&S flow, then the relevant R&S option decision is whether to include K20, and because K20 requires K2, whether to include K2 as well [65][26][36].
